people.name: Peniel
people.line: A place where Jacob wrestled with God

translations.web: He spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, “When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.”
translations.bsb: So Gideon told the men of Penuel, “When I return in triumph, I will tear down this tower!”
translations.kjv: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.
